Settings.EnabledHint: Master switch. When off, hand squares are not drawn for anyone, even with a system module connected.
Settings.SizePercentHint: Size of each hand square as a percent of the token width (15–60).
Settings.AvoidBar: Shift hands above the HP bar
Settings.AvoidBarHint: When enabled, slots automatically move above the bottom HP bar while it is visible. When disabled, they may overlap it.
Settings.LayoutGridHint: Shows a grid and snaps slots to it while dragging.
Settings.LayoutSyncHint: Dragging one slot moves the other mirrored around the token's center.
Settings.ApplyToPlayersHint: When enabled, the slot layout saved in the editor is applied to all players. When disabled, each user has their own layout.
Settings.OnlyInCombatHint: Show the squares only for tokens that are in the current scene's initiative. Hidden otherwise.
Settings.ClickOpensSheet: Clicking a slot opens the item sheet
Settings.ClickOpensSheetHint: A click anywhere on the square opens the item card. When off, the click only selects and drags the token.
Settings.DebugHint: Logs about connected modules and every rendered token — useful for debugging empty slots.
Settings.TokenEnabledHint: Per-token (or per-prototype) switch. When off, the squares are not drawn even while the module is enabled. If unset, the prototype token value is used, then the module-wide setting.
Settings.LayoutMenuHint: Open the visual editor and drag the hand slots around the token. The setting is personal, but with "Configure for players" enabled it is applied to everyone.

Layout.Title: Hand Layout
Layout.Hint: Drag the squares around the token. The green strip at the bottom is the HP bar: if a slot lands on it, it will automatically move above it in game. You can replace the preview background with your own image.
Layout.SyncHint: Move the paired slot mirrored around the token's center
Layout.MasterOnly: The layout is configured by the GM. Only the GM can change it.

TOKEN-HANDS.NoProvider: The "Hands on Token" base module is enabled, but no system module (PF2e / D&D 5e / Cyberpunk RED) has connected. Squares will appear once one is enabled.
